# NATIONAL STEEL & ALLOYS

> Premier Importer, Stockist, Manufacturer & Supplier of Stainless Steel, Alloy Steel, Carbon Steel, and Mild Steel products in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

## About National Steel & Alloys
National Steel & Alloys is an established steel stockist and supplier headquartered in Mumbai, India. We specialize in high-grade industrial raw materials including pipes, tubes, sheets, plates, round bars, fittings, and flanges across various material grades (SS 304, SS 316, SS 304L, SS 316L, Carbon Steel, Alloy Steel, Mild Steel, Brass, Copper, Aluminum).

- Website: https://nationalsteelalloys.com
- Location: 45/49, Gulam Mohammad Building, M.S. Bawan Patel Road, Ramagalli, Mumbai-400 004, Maharashtra, India
- Phone: +91 9769339987 / 022 6743 6635
- Email: nationalstainless@yahoo.com
- GST Number: 27AJJPN4917B2Z9
- CEO: Champak Sain

## Core Product Categories
- [Stainless Steel Products](https://nationalsteelalloys.com/products): Pipes, Tubes, Sheets, Plates, Round Bars, Fittings, Flanges (304, 304L, 316, 316L, 310, 321, 410, 904L grades)
- [Alloy Steel Products](https://nationalsteelalloys.com/products): High-strength alloy steel round bars, plates, and seamless pipes (F11, F22, F91, F9, 4140, 8620, EN19, EN24)
- [Carbon Steel Products](https://nationalsteelalloys.com/products): Seamless pipes, boiler tubes, plates (A106 Gr B, A53, API 5L, A516 Gr 60/70)
- [Mild Steel Products](https://nationalsteelalloys.com/products): MS pipes, angles, channels, beams, flat bars, structural steel
- [Pipes & Tubes](https://nationalsteelalloys.com/products): Seamless, ERW, EFW, Welded pipes in all schedules & sizes
- [Sheets, Plates & Coils](https://nationalsteelalloys.com/products): Cold rolled (CR), Hot rolled (HR), Chequered plates, shim sheets

## Key Services
- Custom Cutting & Sizing (Cutting pipes, bars, and plates to exact lengths)
- Quality Inspection & Material Testing (MTC / Mill Test Certificates available)
- Fast Worldwide & All-India Logistics Dispatch
- Bulk & Custom Order Fabrication Guidance
